task.name: Documentation Completeness Check
task.description: Review newly changed operator-facing documentation pages and surface pages that omit required setup, rollback, or ownership details for the changed workflow or package.
task.intent: Reduce failed operator handoffs caused by incomplete operational documentation after workflow changes without reopening pages that already have tracked completeness gaps.
activationConditions: A pull request merged within the evidence window changes a workflow, package configuration, or operator-facing documentation page.
The current documentation associated with the changed workflow or package omits at least one required operational detail.
requiredEffects: Each novel completeness finding identifies the documentation page, the changed workflow or package, and the missing operational detail category.
Maintainers can accept, reject, or resolve each surfaced finding using repository-linked evidence.
noopConditions: No changed workflow or package has operator-facing documentation with missing required operational details.
Every supported completeness finding for the changed documentation is already tracked.
successConditions: Supported completeness findings receive accepted remediation evidence or an explicit maintainer dismissal within the evidence window.
Changes whose documentation is already complete create no duplicate maintainer attention.
uncertainties: A documentation page may intentionally delegate one operational detail to another canonical page.
One merged pull request can change multiple workflows or packages that share a single documentation page.

operationalValue.statement: The proportion of supported, novel documentation-completeness findings assigned to the run that are resolved or explicitly dismissed within 21 days.
operationalValue.opportunity: One workflow run and the deduplicated supported completeness findings it assigns for the changed documentation set.
acceptedEvidence: A merged pull request that adds the missing setup, rollback, or ownership detail to the identified documentation page.
A closed tracking issue or pull request conversation that explicitly marks the finding resolved or dismissed by a maintainer.
evidenceRepositories: The repository in which the workflow ran.

metric.name: resolved-supported-completeness-findings
metric.formula: resolved-or-dismissed supported findings / supported novel findings assigned to the run

operationalValue.maturation: 21 days after the workflow run completes.
operationalValue.zeroRule: Return 0 when at least one supported novel completeness finding was assigned and none has accepted resolution evidence by the evidence cutoff.
operationalValue.missingRule: Return null when the assigned finding set or required repository evidence for the changed documentation set cannot be read.
